llm.summary: This Google Ads skill is powerful but coherent: it clearly discloses read, write, and removal actions and requires user confirmation before state-changing operations.

dimensions.detail: The skill operates Google Ads through an OOMOL connector, including campaign/ad group mutations and Customer Match list changes; those capabilities match the stated marketing/analytics purpose and are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to inspect live schemas before payload construction, run named googleads connector actions, and confirm exact payloads/effects for writes and explicit approval for destructive removals.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is markdown-only and allows oo CLI usage; it includes one-time setup guidance for installing/signing into oo only when commands fail, including remote installer commands users should review before running.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: OAuth and sensitive credential use are expected for Google Ads management, and the artifact says OOMOL injects credentials server-side rather than asking the agent to handle raw tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, cron jobs, hidden persistence, local credential scraping, or unrelated privilege escalation were found; persistent account connection is limited to the disclosed OOMOL/Google Ads integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent manage Google Ads through OOMOL. Review payloads carefully before approving campaign, ad group, or customer-list writes/removals, because those actions can affect ad spend, targeting, and customer data.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector:clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, and artifact review did not find hidden instructions or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[StaticScan:clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns; local files are markdown instructions for named connector actions.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
